title: Newhalo text and gallery
description: A product section on paper: a 64px heading, paragraphs, a hairline list with small line icons and an orange button on the left; a big square picture on the right with a column of 96px thumbnails (a row under it on phones). The heading wipes in, list lines draw from the left one after another, the gallery blooms in (1.1→1) and the picture drifts inside its frame; thumbnails zoom in staggered.
notes: one slide hides the thumbnails; leave cta out for a plain text block
icons are optional: without them the list is plain hairline rows
